## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Llama 3.1 Tulu 3 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~4.9 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF/tree/7033c16b4f79f8708a27d80bf2ae0c6537253d1b))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~8.5 GB) `llama cli -hf lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Llama 3.1 Tulu 3 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~4.9 GB, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF/tree/7033c16b4f79f8708a27d80bf2ae0c6537253d1b))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~8.5 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~4.5 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-4bit -y` · 8bit (~8.5 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Llama 3.1 Tulu 3 8B (Q4_K_M, needs ~5.32 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/tulu3/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run tulu3:8b-q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~10.14 GB) `ollama run tulu3:8b-q8_0`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Llama 3.1 Tulu 3 8B (4bit, needs ~4.5 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-4bit/tree/ce1fb64f6c7f03cc816f1f86258097e6428ddcc9))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~8.5 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/allenai](https://huggingface.co/allenai/Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B)
